title: Fourteen Autumns and One Short Route
subtitle: 交通运输 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通运输（人与社会·交通与旅游）
meta: 主题语境：交通运输（人与社会·交通与旅游）　|　核心词汇：driver　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 driver 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 my father ① met a driver that no passenger in the station would have thanked, and he said the meeting was the whole of the autumn. The ② driver, meaning the person and not the device, ran fourteen autumns and stayed unnamed in the book; a driver, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left unthanked.

Every ③ driver in that station had the same short route at the end of it, and the ④ driver at the end, meaning the one they kept for the night bus and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A driver, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to ride; my father said the riding is the part that fills fourteen autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the driver was the whole of the story, meaning the device and not the person. The ⑥ driver, meaning the device and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody depends on and nobody mentions; driver, he said, is either something you meet or the only word that means both a person and a device. He said the device is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ driver had become a line in a roster, and the roster had become an argument about the short route. The ⑧ driver of the whole thing, my father wrote in October, was one station and fourteen autumns of riding; driver, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to ride. She said the riding was never mentioned.

The ⑨ driver I remember is the one named in the roster, who retired in 1984 and is still described as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ driver, my mother said in 1986, is the only one who improves by being ridden with; every driver, she said, is a device that has agreed to look like a person. She said the device was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 司机；驾驶员（指那个车站里当班的那一位）
B. n. 司机；驾驶员（指那位司机本人，与驱动装置相对）
C. 固定搭配：meet a driver 见一位司机
D. n. 司机；驾驶员（指留给夜班车的那一位）
E. n. 司机；驾驶员（抽象总称，指一个车站的开车之事）
F. n. 司机；驾驶员（指名册上写到、被列名的那一位）
G. n. 驱动因素；驱动程序（指故事里人人都依赖却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 驱动因素（抽象总称，指人人都依赖却无人提起的那种东西）

items.q: met a driver that no passenger in the station would have thanked
The driver, meaning the person and not the device
the driver was the whole of the story
the driver had become a line in a roster
The driver of the whole thing
A driver, my mother said in 1986

answers.why: meet a driver 意为“见一位司机”，1963 年父亲见了一位车站里没有一位乘客肯道谢的司机。
driver 意为“司机、驾驶员”，指那位司机本人而不是驱动装置，他经过了十四个秋天而在簿子上没有名字。
driver 意为“司机、驾驶员”，指那个车站里的每一位司机，每一位到头都有同一条短短的路线。
driver 意为“司机、驾驶员”，指留给夜班车的那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
driver 意为“驱动因素、驱动程序”，指故事里人人都依赖却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个驱动因素就是那个故事的全部。
driver 意为“驱动因素”，指人人都依赖却无人提起的那种东西而不是那位司机，是故事里人人都依赖、却无人提起的东西。
driver 意为“司机、驾驶员”，指名册上写到、被列名的那一位，到 1972 年这位司机成了名册里的一行。
driver 意为“司机、驾驶员”，父亲十月写道，整件事的开车之事是一个车站和十四个秋天的乘车。
driver 意为“司机、驾驶员”，我记得的是名册上列名的那一位，1984 年退休了，至今仍被说成车站里最安静的一位。
driver 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，一位司机是唯一会因为被好好同乘而变得更好的人。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年父亲见了一位车站里没有一位乘客肯道谢的司机，他说见着才是那个秋天的全部。（meet a driver）
那位司机，指的是那位司机本人而不是驱动装置，经过了十四个秋天而在簿子上没有名字。（driver）

末尾那一位司机，指的是他们留给夜班车的那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（driver）
叔叔说这个驱动因素就是那个故事的全部，指的是驱动因素而不是那位司机。（driver）
1986 年母亲说，一位司机是唯一会因为被好好同乘而变得更好的人。（driver）
